messages:
Maria: quick heads-up — platform API is going to change routing header semantics next week. we need to converge on a non-breaking migration path for SDKs and a console rollout UX. details below.

Aj: ack. what exactly is changing?

Maria: we want to add an explicit header `x-rd-route-priority` that can be one of `standard|high|fallback`. previously clients inferred routing from model strings and an opaque route hint. that inference causes surprises when we fallback to cheaper variants.

Cheng: is the plan to accept both old hint + new header for a while? or do we force clients to set the header?

Maria: transitional mode: API v2 will accept both. servers will prefer `x-rd-route-priority` when present. after 3 months we'll emit deprecation warnings in responses and in telemetry. SDKs should send a client-side warning when they detect old hint usage.

Sam: SDK concern: TS/Go/py all have different routing enums. TS currently treats route type as a string union; py uses constants. a strict enum bump is a semver-major for TS. can we make it a soft-typed string to avoid major?

Jeff: for TS we can keep the union but add the new values as optional. the type safety will catch callers that explicitly use enums, but implicit strings still work. we should document the new header and provide a migration helper.

Katie: console UX: product asked for a rollout switch per-tenant so customers can opt in to the new header semantics before we flip defaults. we also need a telemetry tile showing how many requests specify `x-rd-route-priority` vs inferred.

Maria: yes — plan: add a toggle in Console -> Routes -> Routing policy with three states: inherit (old behavior), explicit-prefer (prefer header), explicit-only (reject if missing). default will be inherit. rollout timeline: toggle visible immediately, default flip (to prefer) after 6 weeks for new accounts, global flip after 3 months.

Cheng: telemetry needed: count by header value, count inference fallback occurrences, and a sampled trace that ties header -> route chosen. can we sample 0.1% by default and 5% for tenants opting into beta?

Sam: for SDK changes — proposal: patch release adds helper functions + docs; minor release adds opt-in header setter; major only if we force enum types. I'd prefer to avoid a breaking major.

Jeff: agree. implement helper APIs:

```ts
// TS example
import { setRoutePriority } from '@redwood/sdk';
setRoutePriority(client, 'high');
```

```py
# Python example
from redwood import set_route_priority
set_route_priority(client, 'high')
```

Maria: also we need server-side deprecation warning header e.g. `x-rd-deprecation: routing-hint` when hint used. that will bubble to SDKs and we can log analytics events to surface top offenders.

Katie: for Console tile: small bar chart + a warning list of tenants that still send hints. add a migration CTA that links to SDK migration guides.

Cheng: regarding quotas: if route-priority='high' we charge the higher per-token rate. need to update billing engine and quota docs. does the change affect reserved capacity routing?

Maria: yes — reserved pools will map high->dedicated fast pool, standard->shared pool, fallback->burst pool. we'll add a quota flag that gates high routes for accounts without dedicated capacity. fallback still allowed. update quota rules in policy engine.

Sam: can we add a temporary telemetry tag `migration.v2.route.header` so we can chart adoption by SDK version? then we can coordinate SDK releases with console flips.

Jeff: done — SDKs will add `x-rd-sdk-version` already, we'll reuse that and add `x-rd-route-migration: v2` in minors that opt-in.

Maria: checklist:
- platform: accept header + deprecation header (Cheng)
- telemetry: sampling + tiles + migration tag (Cheng + Jeff)
- console: toggle + chart + migration CTA (Katie)
- SDKs: patch helpers + opt-in header in next minor (Sam)
- docs: migration guide + examples (Maria/Katie)
- billing: quota mapping + new price tier for high (Finance)

Katie: can we add a small banner in console release notes for tenants in the 3-month global flip window? product wants to send an email too.

Sam: implementation note: in py sdk we'll add runtime warning: use warnings.warn("Using inferred routing is deprecated; set x-rd-route-priority") so unit tests need to ignore that warning.

Aj: sounds reasonable. timeline?

Maria: target: API v2 deploy next Thursday in canary (internal only). SDK patch releases by end of week after canary. console toggle live on Monday. global flip scheduled 3 months from canary.

DeployBot: deploy job queued: canary/api-v2-routing-headers -> started 2162304600

Cheng: I'll land the server PR today and add the `x-rd-deprecation` header. will post link when ready.

Jeff: I'll prepare telemetry dashboards and a short KQL to surface accounts hitting fallbacks.

Sam: I'll draft TS/py patch PRs and add migration tests.

Katie: I'll mock the console toggle and the tile in staging.

Maria: thanks all — follow up in this thread with PR links. if you hit blockers ping me or @pager. :thumbsup:
